title: Emit RFC 8620 rateLimit SetError for slow mode in Message/set
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[chat-core] Emit RFC 8620 rateLimit SetError for slow mode in Message/set
Spec (57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L612: "the server MUST reject messages from non-exempt members sent within this many seconds of their previous message in this channel, with a `rateLimit` SetError ({{RFC8620, Section 5.3}}) on the offending `Message/set` create." L1944-1955 rateLimited registration: "A method-level error ... Returned by the Peer/* methods of {{JMAP-CHAT-FED}}. ... (Per-object rate limits on `/set`, including channel slow mode, use the `rateLimit` SetError of {{RFC8620, Section 5.3}}.)" Compliance L265 (4.10): "Verify the second is rejected with a `rateLimit` SetError (RFC 8620 Section 5.3) in `notCreated`, not the method-level `rateLimited`."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:1455; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:1433-1448 (comment); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:22 (module doc); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs:437,2341,2349 (SlowModeError / slow_mode_check docs); crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/integration.rs:2817-2863 (asserts "rateLimited" and explicitly rejects "rateLimit")
Now: Slow-mode throttle inserts SetError::new(SetErrorType::custom("rateLimited")) into notCreated, so compliance test 4.10 fails.
Change: Use SetErrorType::RateLimit (already defined in crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs:363, wire "rateLimit"); serverRetryAfter extra can stay. Update the docs. The integration.rs:2862-2863 assertion encodes the old spec and must be updated to the new spec text (the oracle changed).
Verifier correction: Same as proposed. The registration citation is draft L2013-2026.
